name: Shipping Package 4
definition: Contains the details of the package

TrackingNumber.name: Tracking Number
TrackingNumber.definition: Contains the identification number for the packages being shipped and is also used for pickup number.

SupplierLegalCorporateName.name: Supplier Legal Corporate Name
SupplierLegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the supplier.

SupplierLocalData.name: Supplier Local Data
SupplierLocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of the supplier data.

SupplierContact.name: Supplier Contact
SupplierContact.definition: Contact information related to the supplier.

PickupDate.name: Pickup Date
PickupDate.definition: Contains the date the package is picked up.

PickupTime.name: Pickup Time
PickupTime.definition: Contains the time the package is picked up.

DeliveryNoteNumber.name: Delivery Note Number
DeliveryNoteNumber.definition: Contains the number identifying an individual delivery note.

WeightUnit.name: Weight Unit
WeightUnit.definition: Unit of measure of the item being shipped.

OtherWeightUnit.name: Other Weight Unit
OtherWeightUnit.definition: Other unit of measure the item being shipped .

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.
